fusions.name: Lazy Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a hanging fruit that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Leans its whole weight on the target, dealing 30 damage, plus 6% of the maximum health of a boss or elite, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Slow Digestion
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Hanging Around
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. You also regenerate 1.2 health a second, permanently.
